titre: Control test n°3 — English (4th year primary, first year)

exercices.enonce:
Read and answer.

I have a pet. It is a cat. Its name is Mimi. Mimi is small and white. I love my cat.

1) What pet does the child have? .......... (2 points)
2) What is its name? .......... (2 points)
3) What colour is Mimi? .......... (2 points)

Animals.
1) Circle the animals: (3 points)
dog — table — cat — book — bird.
2) Complete: (2 points)
A .......... says woof.   A .......... says meow.

True or False, then complete.
1) A cat is an animal. .... (1 point)
2) A pen is an animal. .... (1 point)
3) A dog is a pet. .... (1 point)
4) Complete: I have a .......... . (write an animal) (2 points)

About a pet. Complete. (4 points)
My pet is a .......... .
Its name is .......... .

Food I like.
1) Circle the food words: (2 points)
apple - dog - bread - cat - milk.
2) Complete: (2 points)
I like .......... .   I do not like .......... .
